hook: In Book 15 of Homer's Iliad, 3 divine brothers divided the cosmos between themselves.

sections.voiceover: In Book 15 of Homer's Iliad, 3 divine brothers divided the cosmos between themselves.

sections.sfx_cue: Low thunder rumble blending into ocean swell
b_roll: Ancient Greek manuscript illustration of Mount Olympus

sections.voiceover: During the Titanomachy, the war against the Titans, 12 Olympians overthrew their father Cronus. Who actually held supreme authority during the Trojan War?
sections.visual_cue: Split frame depicting stormy seas beside lightning-lit mountain peaks
b_roll: Illustration of Poseidon trident and sea

sections.voiceover: However, during the Trojan War, Poseidon confronted Zeus, claiming equal dignity despite Zeus's ultimate authority.
sections.visual_cue: Ancient marble relief depiction of Poseidon facing the throne of Olympus

sections.voiceover: Homer shows Zeus maintained ultimate authority on Olympus. In Odyssey Book 13, Poseidon turned a Phaeacian ship into stone after consulting Zeus. Odyssey lines 122 to 184 record Poseidon turning a Phaeacian ship into stone after consulting Zeus.
sections.visual_cue: Classical artwork showing a wooden vessel transforming to stone off a coastline
b_roll: Illustration of Phaeacian ship near stone reef

sections.voiceover: The 2 divine brothers shared cosmic dominion under Zeus.
sections.visual_cue: Dual emblem showing trident and lightning bolt uniting under Olympus crown
b_roll: Ancient Greek temple ruins silhouette against sunset
